name: LineageImpactView
intent: What-if blast radius: given a change to one ontology element, the pipelines, processes and actions it reaches.
when: Before changing or deleting a shared ontology element
Any admin surface answering "what does this break"
whenNot: Tracing where data came FROM -> use the data lineage view
Listing rule violations -> use the lint findings view

chooseOver.because: A list names the neighbours; this walks the graph and reports what a change actually reaches, across pipelines, processes and actions at once.

objectTypeId.note: Deep-linked object type; a routed id wins over the remembered one.

onDetailChange.note: Reports the drill-in segment for a host breadcrumb.

onNavigate.note: Coarse by design — selects a perspective and a tab, not a record.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Reached records are keyed by their own ids across three registries.

states.reached: Pipelines, processes and actions the change would touch.
states.isolated: Nothing downstream depends on the element.

evaluationCriteria: All three downstream registries are walked, not just one.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted from the WC3 lineage perspective (2026-08-26)

extracted: blast-radius walk across pipelines, processes and actions

notes: Promoted in group B of the missing-widgets template review.
